commands.command:
set -eu
git fetch origin work/ux-evolution
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git rev-parse origin/work/ux-evolution)"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
echo "SOURCE_HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
pnpm exec prettier --write docs/HANDOFF_2026-10-11_IONIC_UX.md docs/HANDOFF_NEXT_CHAT.md
pnpm exec prettier --check docs/HANDOFF_2026-10-11_IONIC_UX.md docs/HANDOFF_NEXT_CHAT.md
git diff --check
if test -n "$(git status --porcelain)"; then
 git add docs/HANDOFF_2026-10-11_IONIC_UX.md docs/HANDOFF_NEXT_CHAT.md
 git commit -m "docs(ionic): format fresh next-chat handoff"
 git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/work/ux-evolution
fi
echo "FINAL_HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
echo "WORKTREE";git status --short
